scripts.mvp: npm run build && npm run mvp --workspace @clario/server
scripts.dev:teacher: npm run build --workspace @clario/shared && npm run dev --workspace @clario/teacher
scripts.dev:student: npm run build --workspace @clario/shared && npm run dev --workspace @clario/student
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace @clario/shared && npm run dev --workspace @clario/server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @clario/shared && npm run build --workspace @clario/teacher && npm run build --workspace @clario/student && npm run build --workspace @clario/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @clario/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @clario/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @clario/teacher && npm run typecheck --workspace @clario/student && tsc --noEmit -p apps/common/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @clario/server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @clario/shared && npm run test --workspace @clario/server && vitest run --config apps/common/vitest.config.ts
